title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each point as its own cluster and then merges the closest clusters step by step. Complete linkage means the distance between clusters is the maximum distance between their points.

title: First Step of Clustering
text: Look at the points on the PC1 axis. Identify the two closest points to each other. These will be merged first in agglomerative clustering.

title: Second Step of Clustering
text: After the first merge, consider the new clusters and find the next pair of clusters or points that are closest to each other using complete linkage.

title: Third Step of Clustering
text: Now, determine the clusters after the third step of merging. Use complete linkage to find the maximum distance between clusters.
